Selected flat DEF transfer before same hit mitigation, owner-wide def_steal_max budget shared across targets, retained owner gain when target invalid; end/retreat restores all surviving victims and clears owner.
runtimeMapping.steal: Native named extra ability surfer_steal_def attributeType2/formulaType2, selected keys def_steal/def_steal_max and finishTargetBuffWhenInvalid1/finishOwnerBuffWhenTargetInvalid0. Signed transfers use defFinalFlat outside percentage/multiplicative buffs, with strongest per-victim Steal reduction. See the pinned statTheftSource in arkpedia-narant-gameplay-notes.json. DEF mitigation retains shared zero floor. No victim-DEF-based owner cap is substituted.
runtimeMapping.talent: Selected E1/E2/P5 deployment DP1/2/2/3; test the four cardinal neighboring tiles for other deployed operator units once after paying cost. Talent cost is not a deployment discount.

verificationLimits: No native C# dispatcher, Unity particles/audio or full frame parity recovered; original graphs, literal events and both verified native PPtr chains are retained.

Native OUTPUT_DAMAGE is bridged to local accepted damaged events, not positive HP loss. Dodge, cancellation and invulnerability output ordering is a bounded runtime law, not an independently measured native event trace.

Native StealAttributeAbility body and enum arithmetic are not executable here. Owner-wide cap and invalid-target retention follow serialized fields; low/negative DEF, external multiplicative buffs, and simultaneous canceling modifier order use explicit local flat-transfer/pre-mitigation rules and shared stat/mitigation floors.

Table Solo Traveler cardinal operator rule is implemented; the original native talent validator and its treatment of summoned entities were not recovered. Local operator entities count; tokens/devices do not. No native token-mask parity claim.
